items.title: Pop in C, slash chords
items.notes: I–V/VII–vi–IV with a descending-bass verse and a C/E in the chorus: slash chords with clear roots. Seed 101; tracks: keys (380), bass (52), lead (140), drums (267).

items.title: Rock in E minor
items.notes: Natural minor with a B7 dominant at the cadences: E minor, not G major. Seed 202; tracks: guitar (392), bass (224), lead (142), drums (315).

items.title: Folk waltz in G with a one-beat pickup
items.notes: 3/4 at 100; the melody starts one beat before the first downbeat, which is therefore not at time 0. Seed 303; tracks: guitar (198), bass (64), flute (145), drums (97).

items.title: Jazz ii–V–I in F, swung
items.notes: Sevenths throughout, two chords a bar in places, walking bass and a swung ride: the sevenths vocabulary and swing timing. Seed 404; tracks: piano (384), bass (96), trumpet (100), drums (218).

items.title: Classical piano and violin in A minor
items.notes: No drums, no bass track: Alberti left hand carries the harmony, so beat tracking has no percussion to lean on. Seed 505; tracks: piano-left (192), violin (163).

items.title: Key trap: E-flat major (three flats)
items.notes: Same signature as the C minor twin; here Bb7 resolves to Eb and the melody ends on Eb. Seed 606; tracks: epiano (304), bass (48), flute (124), drums (290).

items.title: Key trap: C minor (three flats)
items.notes: Same instrumentation, tempo and signature as the Eb major twin; G7 (B natural) resolves to Cm and the melody ends on C. Seed 607; tracks: epiano (308), bass (48), flute (131), drums (290).

items.title: Key trap: C major voiced with sixths (C6 / Am7)
items.notes: C6 and Am7 share every pitch class; the cadences (G7→C) and the final C decide the key. Seed 608; tracks: epiano (352), bass (48), flute (119), drums (290).

items.title: Key trap: A minor voiced with sevenths (Am7 / C6)
items.notes: Twin of the C6 work: the same pitch-class content in the verses, E7 (G#) at every cadence, the melody ends on A. Seed 609; tracks: epiano (344), bass (48), flute (136), drums (290).

items.title: Tempo trap: 68 BPM ballad with sixteenth hats
items.notes: The written pulse is 68; sixteenth-note hats make 136 the easy wrong answer. Seed 710; tracks: piano (176), bass (18), clarinet (70), drums (322).

items.title: Tempo trap: 168 BPM with a half-time backbeat
items.notes: The snare lands on 3 only; eighth-note guitar and bass at 168 — 84 is the trap. Seed 711; tracks: guitar (480), bass (288), lead (176), drums (226).

items.title: Tempo step: 100 → 125 → 100
items.notes: A step to 125 for the chorus and back: a single global BPM covers two thirds of the piece at best. Seed 712; tracks: keys (288), bass (48), lead (112), drums (290).

items.title: Ritardando: 120 to 72 over the last four bars
items.notes: Strings, bass and violin, no drums; the last four bars slow linearly per beat — the tempo map is the truth, not one number. Seed 713; tracks: strings (79), bass (24), violin (130).

items.title: Metre change: 4/4 verses, a 3/4 bridge
items.notes: The bridge is eight bars of 3/4 at the same quarter-note tempo; the dominant metre stays 4/4. Seed 714; tracks: keys (360), bass (64), lead (151), drums (315).

items.title: 6/8 ballad at 60 dotted-quarter
items.notes: Beats are dotted quarters (60 BPM); the quarter-note tempo is 90 and the eighth-note rate 180 — both are reported as separate credits. Seed 715; tracks: piano (200), bass (32), flute (54), drums (129).

items.title: Waltz in D at 150
items.notes: Oom-pah-pah at 150; two-bar harmonic rhythm, so the chord scorer sees long segments. Seed 716; tracks: piano (272), bass (96), violin (211), drums (146).

items.title: Film cue: strings, horn and toms in D minor
items.notes: Sustained string pads and a sparse horn line; toms instead of a kit, no hi-hat pulse. Seed 717; tracks: strings (62), bass (20), horn (40), drums (50).

items.title: Bossa nova in A minor
items.notes: Syncopated piano and bass, rim clave over two bars; a half-diminished chord is outside the majmin vocabulary. Seed 718; tracks: piano (213), bass (96), flute (106), drums (350).

items.title: Funk on E7
items.notes: Dominant sevenths on I, IV and V; sixteenth hats, ghost snares and a syncopated bass — dense onsets at 104. Seed 719; tracks: epiano (216), bass (144), trumpet (134), drums (578).

items.title: Reggae in G, one drop
items.notes: Chords only on the offbeats and a kick on beat 3: the downbeat is the beat nobody plays. Seed 720; tracks: skank (192), bass (72), lead (91), drums (266).

items.title: Electronic in F minor, four on the floor
items.notes: Sawtooth arpeggio, synth bass, kick on every beat, claps on 2 and 4. Seed 721; tracks: arp-synth (192), bass (80), lead (82), drums (522).

items.title: Country two-beat in A
items.notes: Root–fifth bass in halves, strummed guitar, fiddle line: the plainest harmony in the set. Seed 722; tracks: guitar (308), bass (48), fiddle (124), drums (290).

items.title: Worship ballad in A-flat with slash chords
items.notes: Pad comping with inversions on every other bar; the bass note, not the root, is what sounds lowest. Seed 723; tracks: pad (64), bass (16), voice-line (72), drums (321).

items.title: Boom-bap in C minor
items.notes: Held electric-piano sevenths, a synth bass, a swung-free boom-bap kit at 90. Seed 724; tracks: epiano (104), bass (96), lead (58), drums (341).
